_handoff.scope: Unauthenticated public-workflow pass for changing the recorded name/holder on an existing BWSSB water or underground-drainage account in Bengaluru. Public V2 Jaladhare and alternate OWC consumer surfaces were inspected, including public FAQ, More Information, Important Docs, application-status dialog, and grievance form. No login, mobile number, OTP, RR number, application number, document, payment, personal data, grievance, or submission was entered.
_handoff.observationNote: The public V2 page visibly routes to new/additional connection and application-status controls; the alternate OWC consumer portal visibly routes to mobile OTP login, new-connection manuals/docs, and an application-status dialog. No existing-account transfer/name-change control or transfer checklist was observed. The blank alternate status lookup displayed the exact validation text `Application ID must be at least 2 characters long`; the V2 blank Send OTP probe did not yield a captured error message, so OTP validation wording remains Unknown.

claims.text: The unauthenticated V2 Jaladhare consumer page exposes `Apply For Connection / Log In`, `Mobile Number`, `Send OTP`, `Enter OTP`, a Submit button, `Enter Your Application number to know the status`, a second Submit button, and `Show All Application`.
claims.notes: Exact visible control labels were recorded. No identifier, OTP, or application number was entered.

claims.text: The V2 public page labels its visible service as permission for `new Connection/Additional Connection for water supply and under Ground Drainage` and its public information describes new-connection payment, application, upload, and status steps.
claims.notes: The visible wording is adjacent new/additional-connection guidance, not an existing-account transfer procedure.

claims.text: No transfer, name-change, or existing-account mutation control was visible on the inspected unauthenticated V2 Jaladhare page or alternate OWC consumer landing page.
claims.notes: This is an unauthenticated public-interface boundary. It does not rule out an authenticated, office, or unindexed route.

claims.text: The alternate OWC portal's public application-status dialog has an Application ID field with placeholder `Enter the application ID eg: 60SE1`, Submit, disabled Reset, and Close; submitting it blank displays `Application ID must be at least 2 characters long`.
claims.notes: Only the blank client-side validation path was used; no application ID or case data was supplied.

claims.text: The V2 `Show All Applications` public page exposes Date Range, Filter, entries-per-page choices 10/25/50/100, Search, sortable application/fee headers, and a visible `Loading...` table row; it does not expose an existing-account name-transfer case in the inspected public state.
claims.notes: The page was observed without entering an application number or collecting rows; loading state may reflect an unavailable/unfinished public data request.

claims.text: The public BWSSB grievance page exposes Consumer Name, Consumer Mobile No, Subject, Application Number, Application Name, Address, Plumber Name, Remarks, and Submit, and displays `Mail Us: eerbc@bwssb.gov.in` and `Toll Free : 1916`.
claims.notes: This is a published contact/complaint lead only. No field was populated and no grievance was submitted.

claims.text: The public BWSSB FAQ publishes `owcenquiry@bwssb.org` and call centre number `080 22238888` for more queries.
claims.notes: The FAQ does not promise that these contacts can amend an account holder; no contact was made.

claims.text: The unauthenticated public pass does not establish the authorised route, eligibility, accepted transfer/name-change documents, prior-holder or succession evidence, arrears/deposit treatment, transfer fee, case status, approval decision, or completion timing for an existing BWSSB account.
claims.notes: This is the explicit public-workflow boundary. Login, submission, payment, upload, and any RR-specific case lookup were not attempted.
